criteria.requirement: Worker-created evidence is reviewable after opening the app, without full-workspace replacement.
evidence: tests/e2e/worker-app-handoff.spec.ts: desktop and mobile Today/Alerts/Journal journey

criteria.requirement: Replaying the same update creates no duplicate evaluations, alerts, jobs, intents, history, or owner-visible work.
evidence: tests/workerHandoff.test.ts: exact batch replay has one evaluation, alert, evidence row and no applied batch
tests/workerHandoff.test.ts: worker replay and matching acknowledgement are duplicate-safe

criteria.requirement: Recipe/version, evaluation identity/time/session, source/provenance/adjustment/freshness/quality, condition outcome and alert context stay exact.
evidence: tests/e2e/worker-app-handoff.spec.ts: exact source rendered in review contexts

criteria.requirement: Newer app decisions, amendments, outcomes, notes and alert review state survive a worker update.
evidence: tests/workerHandoff.test.ts: owner decisions, amendments, outcomes, notes and review state
tests/e2e/worker-app-handoff.spec.ts: newer decision and amendment survive next batch and app reload

criteria.requirement: Overlapping mutable owner state conflicts or safely no-ops; it is not silently merged.
evidence: tests/workerHandoff.test.ts: owner Eye edit returns owner_state_changed and preserves it

criteria.requirement: Malformed, interrupted or incompatible handoff and damaged app persistence retain a recoverable prior valid state.
evidence: tests/workerHandoff.test.ts: malformed checksum and truncated bytes do not mutate input
tests/repository.test.ts: first-save baseline and CAS recovery

criteria.requirement: No-folder, pending/available, applied, stale, partial/missed, conflict, failed/retryable and recovered states are explicit and truthful.
evidence: tests/e2e/worker-app-handoff.spec.ts: permission, pending, applied, stale, partial, missed, conflict, regrant and recovery states

criteria.requirement: In-app review works without SMTP; scheduler, awake machine, data path, alert, notification intent, provider acceptance, confirmed receipt and human review remain distinct.
Bounded leases/retries/catch-up and app persistence/recovery behavior remain in place with additive migration.
evidence: npm run check: 216 tests across worker, notification, market-data, backup, history and recovery suites

criteria.requirement: LOCAL_WORKER and IMPLEMENTATION_STATUS describe the final contract and current CHG-256 verification rather than relying on the September 16 baseline.

qualificationLimitations: Browser journey uses a test directory-handle adapter; browser-native OS chooser was not separately qualified.
No scheduler, awake-machine guarantee, external provider, SMTP recipient, owner data, hosted service or native device was fabricated.
Full Playwright produced one clean 89-pass/1-skip run; later reruns had unrelated intermittent existing Recipes/Eye Composer bounds/focus failures. The R2 handoff journeys passed every run.
